title: YouTube Reportedly Preparing $3 Billion Settlement Over Child Addiction Claims
excerpt: YouTube is reportedly nearing a $3 billion agreement with school districts to resolve claims that its design harms children.
body_html:
YouTube is reportedly nearing a $3 billion agreement with thousands of school districts to resolve claims that its platform features an addictive design that harms children.

According to reports citing sources familiar with the matter, an agreement in principle has been reached. Under the reported terms, the deal would also introduce new safety safeguards designed for teenagers.

This proposed resolution would allow Google to avoid a wave of upcoming legal challenges regarding youth platform usage and mental health impacts.
